note: UK HYROX scene — demo seed. Coach edits by hand or approves from the desk. type: race|sim|brand|venue|meetup. mode: race|watch|both. `date` empty + `when` for unconfirmed.

items.name: HYROX London
items.blurb: The big one. ExCeL gets loud, the doubles queues get long and half the UK scene is either racing or watching. Book hotels the week tickets drop — the Docklands fills fast.
items.when: December + May editions — exact weekends on hyrox.com

items.name: HYROX Birmingham
items.blurb: NEC weekend — flat, fast and easy to get to from everywhere. The default 'first away race' for most of the crew.

items.name: HYROX Manchester
items.blurb: Manchester Central — compact venue, the noise stays close to the floor. Northern crews show up in numbers.

items.name: HYROX Glasgow
items.blurb: Scottish debut for most people — worth the trip for the crowd alone. Pack layers for the queue outside.

items.name: HYROX Cardiff
items.blurb: Smaller venue, friendlier field — a good first 'proper' race if London feels big. Centre hotels are cheap mid-week.

items.name: Squad race simulation
items.blurb: Timed sims — full or half format, splits logged for the databank, debrief over coffee after. Small groups; members get first slots. Dates land on the events board.
